kinds.cache: A value derived from its source and kept: a memo, a probe answered once, a lazily loaded table, a bounded cache or its bookkeeping.
kinds.registration: One page-wide registration: the one instance of a seam a mounted owner installs and callers outside its tree read.
kinds.page: The one live instance of a page-wide mechanism: input state, the cursor, a running tween or queue, an id sequence, a one-per-page flag.

src/agent/connection/model-roster.ts.reason: Model rosters per endpoint, kept until they expire.

src/agent/connection/store.ts.reason: The connection store, the one runner's stop and the page's credential store.

src/agent/exec/screen.ts.reason: The one worker lease that screens assistant output.

src/agent/providers/model-catalog.ts.reason: The live model catalog, fetched at most once per page with retry pacing and a version readers key on. The native capability tables and the change signal follow it.

src/agent/providers/openai.ts.reason: Endpoints that answered a streamed request with a typed tool call, remembered for the page because the runner builds a fresh adapter per turn.

src/agent/providers/vision-verdict.ts.reason: The vision probe's verdict per model, asked at most once per page, with the probes in flight and the signal readers wait on.

src/agent/session/store.ts.reason: The assistant session's store: the one conversation the page holds.

src/agent/tools/inspect.ts.reason: The last quality report per map, the reference the next evaluation is compared against.

src/assets/cursors/cursor-css.ts.reason: The image-set spelling and density probed once per engine. The built cursor CSS is cached per key.

src/assets/image-format.ts.reason: The lossless WebP probe, answered once per page before the app imports its artwork.

src/core/model/object-id.ts.reason: The page's object id sequence, and the id source tests swap for a deterministic one.

src/editor/commands/smart-build.ts.reason: The press the one mounted smart-build cell offers to the command keys.

src/editor/operations/planet-session.ts.reason: The sequence that numbers each editing session's canvas id within the page. Each editor's running shore follower is keyed by its event bus.

src/editor/review/background.ts.reason: The one background review custom tags and planet names each queue on.

src/editor/session/autosave.ts.reason: The page's one autosave timer and its last record.

src/editor/session/planet-editing.ts.reason: The session planet's place in the library, kept until the next library write or session change, so a subscriber reads one snapshot.

src/editor/session/tool-wiring.ts.reason: The curve sessions of the page's one editor, which the tools and the view share.

src/i18n/category-terms.ts.reason: The table generation the category word cache was built for.

src/i18n/context.tsx.reason: The plural rules per locale are built once.

src/i18n/translations.ts.reason: The locale-table registry's arrival count and the loads in flight per locale.

src/io/export/canvas-limits.ts.reason: The browser's canvas size limits, measured once per page.

src/io/share/codec/template-mask.ts.reason: Template masks decoded once per template.

src/io/storage/planet-library.ts.reason: The planet library's change version and its decoded entries, kept while the stored text is unchanged.

src/pipelines/moderation/text/background.reason: The one worker lease background reviews run on.

src/pipelines/moderation/text/lexical.ts.reason: The word matcher, built once from the English dataset.

src/pipelines/moderation/text/segmenter..reason: The segmentation word tables, loaded once on first use. Words added at run time join them.

src/pipelines/planet-scan/ground/color.t.reason: The sRGB-to-linear table for every byte, filled once when the module loads.

src/pipelines/planet-scan/import-video.t.reason: The one scan pipeline, with its workers, a recording imports through.

src/pipelines/planet-scan/scan.worker.ts.reason: The worker's one scan session and the clock pacing its previews.

src/pipelines/stylize/neural/capability..reason: The WebAssembly SIMD probe, answered once per page.

src/pipelines/stylize/neural/lifecycle.t.reason: The count of open leases on the page's neural runtime, which releases it at zero. A signal announces each change.

src/pipelines/stylize/neural/neural.work.reason: Why the worker's runtime fell back from WebGPU, kept for diagnostics. The runtime per backend and the session per model are each created once per worker.

src/pipelines/stylize/neural/session.ts.reason: The neural worker's one client, and the backend and WebGPU fallback reason of the page's last completed run, read by the harness.

src/pipelines/stylize/proc/packs/aquarel.reason: Bloom textures painted once per key.

src/platform/async/http-cache.ts.reason: Each image decode, kept per url.

src/platform/channels/motion-state.ts.reason: The reduced-motion answer the UI installs for non-React readers.

src/platform/channels/overlay-state.ts.reason: How many overlays hold the page's shortcut lock.

src/platform/channels/toast-bus.ts.reason: The toast presenter the shell installs.

src/platform/device/device-quality.ts.reason: The GL quality override a capture installs, and the page's one GL probe.

src/platform/device/viewport-space.ts.reason: The viewport space measured once per page.

src/platform/input/held-keys.ts.reason: The page's held modifier keys and the listener that tracks them.

src/platform/storage/vault.ts.reason: The page's vault key, derived once.

src/state/catalog-search.ts.reason: Search entries per offered list and locale.

src/state/catalog.ts.reason: The offered catalog items, rebuilt whenever an item is indexed. Its indexes by id and by category, and the items known so far, are the registry itself.

src/state/editing/arming.ts.reason: The tool arming derived per store state object.

src/state/editing/edit-mode.ts.reason: The edit-mode resolution per inputs object.

src/state/keymap/held.ts.reason: Held-command tokens, keyed by the overrides they were built from.

src/state/keymap/store.ts.reason: The keymap store: the page's one set of bindings.

src/state/map-stats.ts.reason: Whole-map statistics per grid state, recomputed when its versions change.

src/state/object-index.ts.reason: The object index per grid state, rebuilt when its versions change.

src/state/store.ts.reason: The editor store: the page's one map, executor and registry.

src/state/stylize-versions.ts.reason: The page's one shelf of stylized takes, its id sequence and the map-edit count takes are checked against.

src/state/text-verdicts.ts.reason: The text check's verdict per text for the page, and the signal readers wait on.

src/tools/generation/designer/dressing/p.reason: Species by role and family, read once per offered catalog list.

src/tools/generation/designer/places/dis.reason: Frontage sums computed once per mask array.

src/tools/generation/designer/planet.ts.reason: The anchor rect computed once per template.

src/tools/generation/run/candidate-pool..reason: The page's candidate worker slots, spawned on first use, and whether workers can start at all. Jobs wait in one queue for a free slot.

src/tools/generation/run/candidate.worke.reason: The templates the page sent this worker, each once, since a template is immutable per map.

src/tools/generation/run/candidates.ts.reason: The byte total of the bounded candidate cache, kept beside the cache it measures. The cache itself, its per-candidate bookkeeping and the map fingerprint per grid follow it.

src/tools/generation/stencil/stencil-bro.reason: The browser image adapter the editor installs for the stencil engine.

src/tools/generation/stencil/stencil-pla.reason: The colour palette per material, read from the catalog once.

src/tools/generation/terrain-plan/repair.reason: One reused scratch grid per template, rewritten fully on every plan check.

src/tools/macros/planting/habitat.ts.reason: The resolved habitat row per catalog id, bounded by RESOLVED_MAX.

src/tools/macros/roads/network.ts.reason: Search buffers reused across A* calls with a generation stamp; searches never nest.

src/tools/macros/roads/route-world.ts.reason: The route world per grid state, keyed by its versions.

src/tools/macros/runtime/preview.ts.reason: Bounded macro previews per grid state.

src/tools/placement/probe.ts.reason: One probe view per live map, keyed by its versions and the objects taken off.

src/tools/reading/regions.ts.reason: Region segmentation per mask set, shared by the readings of one evaluation pass.

src/tools/reading/water-bodies.ts.reason: Water bodies per mask set and state, shared by the readings of one evaluation pass.

src/tools/pointer/region/channel.ts.reason: The region brush handler the editor installs; region selection is one page-wide mode.

src/tools/pointer/runtime/tool-set.ts.reason: What each tool declares about itself, built once per page on first ask.

src/ui/agent/character/Character.tsx.reason: The one mounted assistant character's handle.

src/ui/agent/character/intent.ts.reason: The character's one current intent and cue, which the panel writes and the character reads.

src/ui/agent/character/seat.ts.reason: The character's carriage element and its in-flight carry gesture, which an interrupted move retargets. The mounted panel registers the desk element.

src/ui/agent/sketchbook/Sketchbook.tsx.reason: Which small ritual plays next between sketches, in turn across the page.

src/editor/export/brand.ts.reason: Brand images per url, loaded once.

src/ui/help/facts.ts.reason: Help facts per key, derived once.

src/ui/help/figures/previews/camera.tsx.reason: The camera recording of the subject map, kept while that map is the subject.

src/ui/help/figures/previews/generate.ts.reason: Help preview shots per sample, each a real run cached for the page.

src/ui/help/figures/previews/picture-ban.reason: The 3D card's stills, captured once per map. One finished painting per locale serves every band figure.

src/ui/help/figures/previews/share.tsx.reason: The finished map the generator builds once per page for the full-list figure. Each card's shot is cached per seed.

src/ui/help/figures/scenes/generate.ts.reason: A designed run's command list per scene and region, planned once and replayed on every loop.

src/ui/help/figures/standup-queue.ts.reason: The queue that serializes renderer startup across the page's Help figures.

src/ui/help/search.ts.reason: The Help search index, keyed by the locale it was built for.

src/ui/chrome/modals/load/map-load.ts.reason: The region under the pointer, written by the disc's listener and read by the disc and its window.

src/editor/operations/transfer-map.ts.reason: Transfer previews per map version and destination.

src/view/map2d/capture/planet-painter.ts.reason: Rasters per map and dropped-cell list, fresh maps per template, landmark icons loaded once, and the canvases waiting to repaint when one arrives.

src/ui/design/ui-zoom-anim.ts.reason: The page's one interface zoom tween: the shown and target scale, its frame and the last frame's time.

src/ui/design/visual-rect.ts.reason: Whether the engine reports zoomed rects in screen pixels, probed once.

src/ui/primitives/scroll-geometry.ts.reason: The scroll watch per observed element, which the one page observer serves.

src/ui/primitives/surface-scope.tsx.reason: The click a swallowed press still owes, whose listener outlives the surface stack. The page keeps one stack of open surfaces.

src/ui/primitives/wheel-horizontal.ts.reason: The mounted horizontal-wheel rows the one page listener serves.

src/ui/session/arrival-bus.ts.reason: The one arrival listener and the arrival latched until it registers.

src/ui/session/restore-offer.ts.reason: The dismiss of the restore offer the shell shows.

src/ui/shell/splash/idle-warm.ts.reason: Whether the page's idle artwork decode has started.

src/ui/shell/splash/preload.ts.reason: The page's one preload run and its last reported progress, which a remounted splash attaches to.

src/ui/shell/use-dock.ts.reason: The page's one panel dock motion and the snapshot React reads of it.

src/view/active-view.ts.reason: The tool manager the editor installs for the active view. The active view itself is the other half of that seam.

src/view/hover-target.ts.reason: The one hover target the views write and the shell reads.

src/view/interaction/cursor-controller.t.reason: The page's one cursor: its state, the elements it is applied to, overlay claims and the busy animation.

src/view/interaction/map-wheel.ts.reason: The wheel sink the mounted map view installs.

src/view/interaction/nav-gesture-hint.ts.reason: Whether the navigation hint has shown this page session.

src/view/map2d/capture/thumbnail.ts.reason: The queue that runs one capture at a time on the renderer's off-stage scene. The bounded shots per map and their pending captures follow it.

src/view/map2d/draw/fill-graphics.ts.reason: Pixi colour strings per fill and tint, a handful per map.

src/view/map2d/draw/icon-texture.ts.reason: The icon LOD version that readers of the icon texture cache key on. The texture, base texture and colour caches are what it versions.

src/view/map2d/draw/particles.ts.reason: The live particle count across every burst, which the budget caps.

src/view/map2d/draw/road-surface.ts.reason: Road textures and matrices per material, uploaded once and shared by every surface.

src/view/map2d/layers/overlay/ghost.ts.reason: One ghost glyph texture per glyph, uploaded once.

src/view/map2d/scene/renderer-registry.t.reason: The live 2D renderer the canvas installs.

src/view/map3d/draw/icon-color.ts.reason: Icon colours per url, sampled once.

src/view/map3d/layers/overlay/ghost.ts.reason: Ghost card textures per key, cached for the page and shared by every overlay.

src/view/map3d/models/build-model.ts.reason: Built model geometries per model and deck key, shared by every scene.

src/view/map3d/models/cache-lease.ts.reason: The count of leases on the 3D model caches, which are disposed at zero.

src/view/map3d/models/object-archetypes..reason: Archetype geometries shared by every scene, freed by the last scene's lease.

src/view/map3d/scene/renderer-registry.t.reason: The live 3D scene the canvas installs, and the map it was built for.

src/view/shared/overlay/preview-cell-ras.reason: Preview icon and hatch rasters, drawn once each.

src/view/shared/overlay/overlay-view-syn.reason: The region cells and path drape last shown, replayed to a view that mounts later.

src/view/shared/road/material-texture.ts.reason: Road material canvases per pattern, drawn once.

src/view/shared/road/material.ts.reason: The clipper library, loaded once, and the bounded road material caches with their bookkeeping. The listeners waiting for the library and the shared patch and spec-id caches follow it.

src/view/shared/road/pattern.ts.reason: A stable key per pattern object.

src/view/shared/road/surface-image.ts.reason: Road surface images per url, loaded once.

src/view/shared/road/tile-texture.ts.reason: Road tile canvases per url, and the redraw and readiness waiters for urls still loading.

src/view/shared/viewport/parked-camera.t.reason: A saved camera per map, waiting for the view that draws that map.
